block_factorys_bosses:sandworm.activation: Sirok is present at the nest and begins the encounter when it acquires a player target.
block_factorys_bosses:sandworm.preparation: Prepare for a mobile encounter with poison attacks and room to recover between charges.
sourceNotes: Native structure sandworm_nest.nbt contains block_factorys_bosses:sandworm; sandworm_nest biome tag selects minecraft:desert.
SandwormEntity PATROL_STATE starts fight with a Player target; bite applies Poison.
data/block_factorys_bosses/loot_table/entities/sandworm.json

cataclysm:ignis.location: Burning Arena, generated in Nether Wastes.
cataclysm:ignis.activation: Place Burning Ashes into the Altar of Fire to summon Ignis. The offering is consumed after a successful summon.
cataclysm:ignis.preparation: Bring Burning Ashes and prepare your recovery supplies before placing the offering.
sourceNotes: Native burning_arena worldgen and biome tag; burning_arena2.nbt contains altar_of_fire.
AltarOfFire_Block_Entity.tick checks BURNING_ASHES, creates IGNIS and clears the offering.
data/cataclysm/loot_table/entities/ignis.json

twilightforest:snow_queen.location: Aurora Palace in the Twilight Forest.
twilightforest:snow_queen.activation: Find the Snow Queen inside the palace. Use the Twilight Forest progression and Magic Map to plan the expedition.
twilightforest:snow_queen.preparation: Prepare for the palace journey as well as the boss encounter; the eye is awarded on the Snow Queen’s defeat.
sourceNotes: Native Snow Queen entity and Aurora Palace structures; native snow_queen entity loot table.
data/twilightforest/loot_table/entities/snow_queen.json

legendary_monsters:overgrown_colossus.activation: Find the Colossus in the generated ruins rather than crafting a summoning offering.
legendary_monsters:overgrown_colossus.preparation: Explore the temple with your combat equipment ready; this encounter also rewards a Nature Crystal.
sourceNotes: Native mossy_temple.nbt and mossy_ruins.nbt contain overgrown_colossus; native loot table includes nature_crystal.
data/legendary_monsters/loot_table/entities/overgrown_colossus.json

cataclysm:the_harbinger.activation: Use a Nether Star on the dormant Harbinger to activate it. The star is consumed in survival.
cataclysm:the_harbinger.preparation: Bring one Nether Star for the activation and finish preparing before interacting with the dormant boss.
sourceNotes: Native ancient_factory worldgen; the_harbinger structure.
The_Harbinger_Entity.mobInteract checks Items.NETHER_STAR while inactive and consumes one.
data/cataclysm/loot_table/entities/the_harbinger.json

archaion:last_of_deepslate.activation: Feed the sleeping guardian four Echo Charges. The fourth begins its awakening.
archaion:last_of_deepslate.preparation: Carry four Echo Charges and prepare before offering the last charge.
sourceNotes: Native advancement kill_last_of_deepslate identifies the guardian of Ancient Keep.
LastOfDeepslate.mobInteract/feedEchoCharge consumes EchoChargeItem; requiredEchoCharges = 4.
data/archaion/loot_table/entities/last_of_deepslate.json

alexscaves:luxtructosaurus.location: A volcano in the Primordial Caves.
alexscaves:luxtructosaurus.activation: Toss an Ominous Catalyst into the top of the volcano to awaken Luxtructosaurus and trigger its eruption.
alexscaves:luxtructosaurus.preparation: Prepare away from valuable builds: the eruption and the boss can destroy terrain. Fire protection alone does not remove the physical attack threat.
sourceNotes: Native Cave Compendium primordial_caves/luxtructosaurus describes volcano, Ominous Catalyst, destructive attacks and Tectonic Shards.
Native luxtructosaurus loot table includes tectonic_shard.
data/alexscaves/loot_table/entities/luxtructosaurus.json

mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.activation: Find the Ferrous Wroughtnaut in its chamber.
mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.preparation: Prepare before approaching the armored guardian; its native player-kill rewards include the Axe of a Thousand Metals and Wrought Helm.
sourceNotes: Native wrought_chamber structure and wroughtnaut_chamber.nbt contain ferrous_wroughtnaut.
Native ferrous_wroughtnaut loot table gives wrought_axe and wrought_helmet with killed_by_player conditions.
data/mowziesmobs/loot_table/entities/ferrous_wroughtnaut.json

minecraft:wither.location: A site chosen for the summon.
minecraft:wither.activation: Build the vanilla Wither arrangement using four soul sand or soul soil blocks and three Wither Skeleton Skulls.
minecraft:wither.preparation: Choose a separate arena before placing the last skull. The Wither remains accessible without a chapter unlock.
sourceNotes: Vanilla Wither summoning pattern; TK3 has no added Wither summon gate.
Pack gameplay_drops_191 guarantees the eye; entity modifier removes previous Wither Eye rolls before adding one.

aether:valkyrie_queen.activation: Collect ten Victory Medals, speak to the Queen and accept her challenge. She consumes the ten medals to ready the fight.
aether:valkyrie_queen.preparation: Bring all ten Victory Medals before beginning the dialogue. The challenge cannot begin on Peaceful difficulty.
sourceNotes: ValkyrieQueen.finalizeSpawn uses AetherStructures.SILVER_DUNGEON.
ValkyrieQueen.handleNpcInteraction requires and consumes10 VICTORY_MEDAL; refuses challenge on Peaceful.
data/aether/loot_table/entities/valkyrie_queen.json

ars_nouveau:wilden_boss.location: A Ritual Brazier at a site chosen for the ritual.
ars_nouveau:wilden_boss.activation: Run the Summon Wilden ritual and augment it with one Wilden Horn, one Wilden Wing and one Wilden Spike. Without all three, it summons ordinary Wilden instead.
ars_nouveau:wilden_boss.preparation: Keep the ritual away from valuable blocks: the Chimera’s summon clears space around the brazier.
sourceNotes: RitualWildenSummoning.isBossSpawn checks all three Wilden drops; tick creates WildenChimera and clears eligible nearby blocks.
Native entity translation is Wilden Chimera, although entity ID is wilden_boss.
Native tooltip.ars_nouveau.wilden_tribute explicitly identifies defeating the Wilden Chimera as acquisition.

cataclysm:maledictus.location: Frosted Prison, generated in Snowy Plains.
cataclysm:maledictus.activation: Interact with a ready Cursed Tombstone. Its powered state allows activation; an unready tombstone must finish its cooldown.
cataclysm:maledictus.preparation: The tombstone summons Maledictus after activation and is destroyed by the successful summon.
sourceNotes: Native frosted_prison biome tag selects snowy_plains; frosted_prison_bottom_7.nbt contains cursed_tombstone.
Cursed_Tombstone_Block.useItemOn checks POWERED then sets LIT. Cursed_tombstone_Entity summons Maledictus and destroys the tombstone.
data/cataclysm/loot_table/entities/maledictus.json

cataclysm:the_leviathan.location: Sunken City in deep ocean biomes.
cataclysm:the_leviathan.activation: Place an Abyssal Sacrifice into the Altar of Abyss. The offering is consumed on a successful summon.
cataclysm:the_leviathan.preparation: Prepare underwater breathing and movement for the submerged arena. Leviathan is invulnerable outside water.
sourceNotes: Native sunken_city worldgen and biome tags; sunken_city_lower.nbt contains altar_of_abyss.
AltarOfAbyss_Block_Entity.tick consumes ABYSSAL_SACRIFICE and creates THE_LEVIATHAN.
Native entity.cataclysm.the_leviathan_immune translation states invulnerability outside water.
data/cataclysm/loot_table/entities/the_leviathan.json

cataclysm:ancient_remnant.activation: Excavate suspicious sand in the pyramid for a Necklace of the Desert, then use the necklace on the dormant Ancient Remnant. It is consumed in survival.
cataclysm:ancient_remnant.preparation: Bring a brush for the pyramid excavation and finish preparing before returning the necklace.
sourceNotes: Native cursed_pyramid worldgen and kill_remnant advancement description identify suspicious sand excavation.
Ancient_Remnant_Entity.mobInteract consumes NECKLACE_OF_THE_DESERT while getNecklace false.
data/cataclysm/loot_table/entities/ancient_remnant.json

block_factorys_bosses:underworld_knight.location: Underworld Arena in Nether Wastes or Soul Sand Valley.
block_factorys_bosses:underworld_knight.activation: Use an Underworld Arena Key to open the arena door, then enter Helvar’s chamber. Opening the door consumes one key.
block_factorys_bosses:underworld_knight.preparation: Find keys in arena treasure, arena trial-spawner rewards or drops from Soul Skeletons and Soul Knight Wither Skeletons.
sourceNotes: Native underworld_arena biome tag and spawn_overrides; underworld_arena_1.nbt contains underworld_knight.
data/block_factorys_bosses/loot_table/entities/underworld_knight.json
BossesRiseBlocks registers UNDERWORLD_ARENA_DOOR with UNDERWORLD_ARENA_KEY; HugeDoorBlock.useItemOn consumes one valid key.

Native key acquisition: loot_table/chests/underworld_arena_rare.json, chests/underworld_arena_vault.json, entities/soul_skeleton.json, entities/soul_knight_wither_skeleton.json, spawners/underworld_arena/underworld_arena_key.json.

legendary_monsters:posessed_paladin.activation: Interact with the sleeping Possessed Paladin in the Collapsed Kingdom to begin its awakening.
legendary_monsters:posessed_paladin.preparation: Prepare for the named arena encounter before approaching the Paladin. Its native rewards include a Corrupted Soul and Soul Greatsword.
sourceNotes: Native collapsed_kingdom_arena.nbt contains posessed_paladin. ModEntities maps this ID to IAnimatedBoss.PossessedPaladin.PossessedPaladinEntity.
Native posessed_paladin entity loot table includes corrupted_soul and soul_great_sword.
data/legendary_monsters/loot_table/entities/posessed_paladin.json
Registered PossessedPaladinEntity.mobInteract changes sleeping attack state34 to awakening state35 without requiring an item.
